thread.text:
Hi,

+Winnie (agent) to help us schedule this one. Could you find us 30 minutes
next week for an intro call? Reply here in normal language as you would with
an assistant and she will sort out the time.

Bob

Hello,

I'm Winnie, Bob's virtual assistant. Bob asked me to set up 30 minutes with you on a Meet link. Here are times that work on his side:

- Tue, Oct 13, 9:30am to 10:00am ET
- Tue, Oct 13, 12:30pm to 1:00pm ET
- Fri, Oct 16, 4:15pm to 4:45pm ET

If one of those suits, say so and I will send the invite. If none do, send me a couple of times that work for you and I will check them.

Winnie
Virtual scheduling assistant to Bob, Example Co

sent.summary: Offered three times on a Meet link, Bob in cc. (The ledger row in the capture carries no rationale; this line stands in.)

thread.text: Thanks for the options, but this doesn't work for me right now. Let's leave it for the moment and I will come back to you.

expect.basis: Plan 60 in the proof round of design/scheduling-agent.md (2026-10-11 00:00 to 00:26, known-good/2026-10-10T23-52-16): two steps, record_no with out true and their words, then tell_bob ("... went out on the intro call plan ... the plan is closed and the 3 holds on your calendar are released"). Defect 3 of the five-scenarios section: a decline must close the plan, and propose, ask and book refuse after.
expect.notes: decisionClass close is graded from a record_no with out true; a plain record_no (no out) grades as none. 'Nothing proposed after' is V8 (fires on an outward action once the plan is closed) plus the class (a propose makes the class propose).
